description: This file defines an HTTPService interface and its implementation for making HTTP requests with custom transport settings, including security and configuration handling, specific to the Mattermost server.

classes.name: HTTPServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the HTTPService interface, providing methods to create HTTP clients and transports with security configurations.

classes.name: pluginAPIConfigServiceAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to allow plugin.API to satisfy getConfig interface for configuration access.

methods.name: splitFields
methods.description: Utility function to split a rune into fields based on whitespace or comma.

methods.name: MakeHTTPService
methods.description: Factory function to create an HTTPService instance with a given configuration service.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Method to retrieve the current configuration from pluginAPIConfigServiceAdapter.

methods.name: MakeHTTPServicePlugin
methods.description: Factory function to create an HTTPService using a plugin API.

methods.name: MakeClient
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client with a custom transport and timeout.

methods.name: MakeTransport
methods.description: Creates a custom transport with security settings based on configuration and trust parameters.
